description: Fortra GoAnywhere MFT GACMD REST API integration. Each declared GoAnywhere Project becomes a daily-partitioned Dagster asset with a retry policy. Ships with a rerun op, a dashboard-summary op, a reconciliation op/job, an external-execution monitor sensor, an inbound-trigger sensor, and an hourly reconciliation schedule. demo_mode=true simulates the full GACMD REST API lifecycle on stdout so the whole component runs end-to-end with zero external dependencies (GoAnywhere's official Docker images need a trial or paid license key to do anything).

outputs.description: One daily-partitioned Dagster asset per GoAnywhere Project + optional source-file assets + 3 ops/jobs + 2 sensors + 1 schedule.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Simulate the GACMD REST API on stdout (no external calls).

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.description: GoAnywhere MFT REST API base URL (used when demo_mode=false).

projects.label: Projects
projects.description: GoAnywhere Projects to wrap as daily-partitioned Dagster assets. Each item: {project_name, asset_name, description?, domain?, job_name?, job_queue?, mode?, priority?, variables?}.

source_files.label: Source Files
source_files.description: Files/folders landed by GoAnywhere that Dagster observes (adds to lineage). Each item: {path, asset_name, description?, group_name?, produced_by?}.

upstream_deps.label: Upstream Deps
upstream_deps.description: Upstream asset keys (slash-separated for nested keys) that must complete before projects run.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Dagster asset group for the project assets.

goanywhere_user_env.label: GoAnywhere User Env Var
goanywhere_user_env.description: Env var holding the GoAnywhere REST username (or an admin API key).

goanywhere_password_env.label: GoAnywhere Password Env Var
goanywhere_password_env.description: Env var holding the GoAnywhere REST password (or the admin API key value).

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between GoAnywhere job status polls.

poll_timeout_seconds.label: Poll Timeout Seconds
poll_timeout_seconds.description: Total seconds to wait for terminal state before failing.

partition_start_date.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start_date.description: Start date for the daily partitioned assets.

reconciliation_cron.label: Reconciliation Cron
reconciliation_cron.description: Cron for the GoAnywhere vs Dagster state reconciliation job.

name: GoAnywhereIntegration
